t: A purple fluid made of plants, dyes and some questionable things like skulls in a $(l:generators/bioreactor)Bioreactor$(). $(br2)Used in a $(l:generators/biofuel_generator)Biofuel Generator$() or in $(l:tools/infinity_tools)Infinity Tools$().
一种由植物、染料以及一些可疑成分（比如颅骨）在$(l:generators/bioreactor)生物质炉$()中制成的紫色液体。$(br2)可用于$(l:generators/biofuel_generator)生物燃油发电机$()或$(l:tools/infinity_tools)无限工具$()。
